summary: Peak outdoor-living season met a Google Business Profile that publishes like clockwork. The 4-posts-a-week cadence kept Omega visible for design, installation, and hardscape searches while local rankings continued to firm up.
coverSub: How a relentless local content cadence kept Omega in front of homeowners through the busiest landscaping month of the year.
headline: Profile activity climbed again on the strength of 17 hyper-localized posts and the CMHA certification woven through the content. Calls and direction requests both grew as summer projects kicked off.
snapshotLead: June is when homeowners commit to outdoor projects. Profile views and calls rose together, which means the content is reaching people who are ready to buy.
takeaway: Local SEO gains compound slowly and then all at once. Six weeks of consistent, neighborhood-level content is now showing up as real calls and direction requests, not just impressions.
